claims.statement: The explicit twenty-block shared parity tag codec of proof.md for 1000 information bits on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses has uniform-message average block error at most 999376364468155741/1000000000000000000.
The stated scalar bsc-ops-v1 decoder for the same fixed shared parity tag code executes at most the integer W=164616 operations for every received word, with W<=2^(17329/1000).

experiments.purpose: Recompute one of the four exact tag spectrum sectors from fixed code columns, and verify the occupied-volume product and primitive count.
